_about: The Crown of Bone (levels 64-68): thralls, archers, priests, reavers and wraiths answer the rattle of bone, the juggernauts and ribcage sentinels are elites, the Charnel Choir Vicar and the Ossuary Harvester sub-bosses, and the Bone-Crowned Sovereign on the Throne of Bones raising legion after legion while starving those who stand still.
